verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an observability SaaS that stores customer telemetry, so the axis applies. The pack contains only page titles (Log Management, Sensitive Data Scanner, Audit Trail), and none documents configurable retention periods or data deletion. Sensitive Data Scanner is an adjacent redaction feature, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
